title: Keep useful content in one or two readable pages
summary: One or two pages, including a page and a half, are acceptable.
body: One or two pages, including a page and a half, are acceptable. Preserve useful content, maximum four bullets per employer, readable fonts/spacing and sensible breaks. If a draft reaches three pages, inspect formatting, duplication and verbosity first. If it still exceeds two, preserve it and report the problem. This replaces the old one-page requirement and complicated subset selection.
